head: ef6a3fe
summary:
Implemented all 29 owned ReadsCalc operations plus portfolio/discovery/full-trend and stored-brief seams.
HALTED under hard-stop 1: shared mediator lifetime, framework probe composition and standalone provider validation require unowned changes.
Verified code commit ef6a3fe: strict whole build and format pass; final owned fast selection 28/28 passes.
Whole fast gate remains red: 723 passed, 13 failed in framework/contract tests.
Six complete ordinary-host scenarios: raw ReadsCalc 241/514 (46.89%), not a passing replay gate.
Page-independent counts meet Stage 2 but conflict with recorded numeric metadata; no numeric waiver was made.
Local implementation and documentation commits only; no push, shared source edit, package or live integration.

deviations.what: Unfiltered unit population metadata uses unbounded existing Gold ports when a page limit is present.
deviations.why: Stage 2 requires page-independent totals, but Python/W1 recordings bound them by displayed rows. P1 limit-1 is 21/10 rather than recorded 1/1; P2 detail is 26/13 rather than 3/3. No numeric improvement waiver exists.

deviations.what: Reviews and ingestion exception annotations use durable versioned lookup records rather than private process-global state.
deviations.why: Reopening and reset behavior must use the existing persistence boundaries. The certified writer and Claims finding lifecycle are unchanged.

deviations.what: No fake IPortfolioReferenceData adapter is supplied.
deviations.why: W1 pay-period ports contain no hire dates. Sibling consumers need a genuine outer binding for the separate synthetic annual-payroll reference and worksite metadata.

deviations.what: Remaining heavy comparisons and a fresh full replay after the final local reviewer fix are deferred at the mandatory shared-boundary halt.
deviations.why: The shared runtime/probe repairs require unowned edits. Previously reported isolated P2 passes do not prove ordinary multi-reset behavior.

findings: Shared singleton Mediator resolves scoped handlers through its captured root provider; ordinary P1-to-P2 replay retains the first CSV/fiscal adapters.

Existing Framework and RuntimeTrust tests map GET /api/scope as a probe, causing AmbiguousMatchException after the real endpoint is implemented; endpoint order cannot satisfy their Assert.Single requirement.

ProviderSelectionTests validates automatically discovered Application handlers without registering feature collaborators and reports Unable to resolve service for type ReadsCalculationViews and other feature services.
W1 GoldReader.PeopleTotal and Python recordings return the limited displayed count for unfiltered population metadata.
F-3 and F-4 now reach deliberate JSON 422 refusals through existing binding/validation boundaries; F-1 magnitude is bounded.
Captured ingestion precedence M-01 and first-program credit_math pricing remain unchanged because correcting them changes figures.
FS-01/FS-11, CQ-02/CQ-05 and CAP-10 retain their documented legacy fiscal/filter/QC boundaries.
Source count/max fingerprints are not Delta snapshots or count/max-preserving edit detection; strict leap-window bridge coverage remains partial.
Missing sibling claim/run/base-year/rebase handlers cause later run-identity and override discrepancies; those are not fabricated or registered as numerical improvements.
open_questions: The shared mediator/current-request-scope contract and framework probe override contract require integration ownership.
The unchanged-number policy conflicts with Stage 2 population-count metadata requirements.
The legacy employee-review route lacks tenant scope and retains a documented client-zero namespace.

needs_human.item: Authorize shared mediator lifetime/current-scope repair and a single-host P1-to-P2-to-P1 reset test.
needs_human.why: The correction belongs outside ReadsCalc; scoped source/fiscal collaborators must not be captured at the root.

needs_human.item: Settle framework probe and standalone Application/provider-validation composition.
needs_human.why: Existing tests pin /api/scope as their own probe and omit feature services. Correcting their assumptions requires files outside this session's ownership.

needs_human.item: Reconcile defective unfiltered-count recordings with the explicit page-independence requirement.
needs_human.why: Honest totals change recorded numbers, which cannot be waived. Recordings/comparisons were not weakened.

needs_human.item: Supply the outer IPortfolioReferenceData adapter for sibling portfolio/discovery consumers.
needs_human.why: Hire dates are absent from W1 pay-period ports; a first-paycheck surrogate or fake zero is not legitimate.

needs_human.item: Review M-01 ingestion precedence, multi-program first-pack pricing and retained legacy fiscal boundaries separately.
needs_human.why: The task explicitly forbids route-layer corrections that change their calculated figures.

needs_human.item: Decide tenant scoping for the legacy employee review contract.
needs_human.why: Its URL/body does not identify a client; changing the existing employee-key namespace requires an API contract decision.
